title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.2 code execution was possible in Safe Mode via project-controlled JVM…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.2 allows code execution in Safe Mode via project-controlled JVM options of the build process. This flaw could enable an attacker to execute arbitrary code with limited privileges when Safe Mode is enabled.
